page.notes: Right margin note, lower part: printed "*Idem Obaidi-anorum qui se-Eta quedam Moriiorum er-ror, teste Sha-reftan." The word "Eta" (probably the end of "sekta") and "Moriiorum" (probably "Moriorum") are doubtful; the note is rendered with the printed hyphens joined. The mark "*" in the text after "Deum" is the reference to this note. Doubtful readings in the Arabic: the lines are copied from the scan, and the words "ضروه" and "وفرة" are marked [?]. "simplicis" is marked [?] because the scan reads "simpltcis". The word "ipsū" is printed with a macron over the u. Catchword "plaraque" is at the right below the last line; the last line of the column ends with "quorum". Running head and page number are at the top of the page. The printed "Gg 3" is the gathering signature.
